#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s RELEASE_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
releases_root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$base/releases" && pwd -P)

case $1 in
    /*) candidate=$1 ;;
    *)  candidate=$base/$1 ;;
esac

    printf 'publish: release directory not found: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 66

reader() {
